about.heading: About
paragraphs: PBLAND9 started in June 2026 and works in Korea and Japan. The music service is already running: the API and Claude talk, and Claude returns bottlenecks and insights for C-level leaders at a leading K-pop company.

know-thyself became a popular Toss mini app. It compares take-home pay across 13 cities. A lotto tool has given more than 20,000 people a meaningful purchase. KakaoTalk API work, and the jobs around it, has saved more than 20,000 hours. A YouTube channel we worked on grew.
We also help public-sector teams with image-making, so they can communicate more clearly.

founder.title: About the founder
founder.description: The founder of PBLAND9 studied in Japan and has worked in consulting and corporate strategy.
paragraphs: The founder studied at a leading university in Japan and holds several professional qualifications.
The experience includes a top consulting firm, and a strategy office inside a company, supporting the C-suite.
The work covers many projects across media and technology.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: We talk through what you want to build, and how much of it is needed now.

steps.title: Confirm scope
